name: repo-watcher
description: Watches external frontend/backend repos and generates feature docs + QA test cases from pushed diffs.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @watcher/shared && npm run build -w @watcher/server && npm run build -w @watcher/worker && npm run build -w @watcher/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,server,worker,web -c gray,cyan,magenta,green "npm run dev -w @watcher/shared" "npm run dev -w @watcher/server" "npm run dev -w @watcher/worker" "npm run dev -w @watcher/web"
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/dist apps/*/dist
